top_signals.title: EDP CEO Sees Opportunities in US Renewable Energy
top_signals.summary: EDP CEO Miguel Stilwell d'Andrade speaks to Bloomberg's Anna Edwards and Tom Mackenzie on The Opening Trade. The US already accounts for 60% of EDP's planned renewable energy investments through 2028 with Stilwell saying the Portuguese energy company could add further US investment in a new business plan extending beyond 2028 to be presented next year. (Source: Bloomberg)
